senses.gloss: f. (v. בַּר II) daughter, child, issue; young tree.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 30:21">Targ. Gen. XXX, 21</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 141a:4">B. Bath. 141ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ נמי וכ׳</he> the Lord did not suffer Abraham to be even without a daughter.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 9b:21">M. Kat. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ אוכמתא</he> Ms. M., v. <cite ref="A00648"><he>אוּכָּם</he></cite>. Y. B. Mets. III, 8ᶜ bot. <he>ב׳ נוקבה</he> female issue.
Lev. R. s. 25 ב׳ פחין a mean woman.—ב׳ קלא = בַּת קוֹל.—ב׳ שבע a species of figs.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15:7">Gen. R. s. 15</cite>, end (h. <he>בנות שבע</he>). Y. B. Bath. II, end, 13ᶜ <he>ב׳ שובעין חיורין</he> white figs; a. fr. [For other compounds, v. respective determinants.]—Pl. <cite ref="B00961"><he>בְּנָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00939"><he>בְּנָאתָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00968"><he>בְּנָתָן</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 10:9">Targ. Y. Ex. X, 9</cite> <he>בְּרַתָנָא</he> our daughters.] <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 5:4">Targ. Gen. V, 4</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 4:11">Keth. IV, 11</cite> <he>ב׳ נוקבין</he>, v. <cite ref="B01154"><he>בַּר</he> II</cite>.
